title: Comparison of BuMA eG Based BioDegradable Polymer Stent With EXCEL Biodegradable Polymer Sirolimus-eluting Stent in "Real-World" Practice
brief_summary: PANDA III is sought to investigate the safety and efficacy of a PLGA-polymer with electro-grafting base layer sirolimus-eluting stent (SES) versus a PLA-polymer SES at 12 months follow-up.
